summary: Solowin Holdings filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of up to $6.48M in Class A ordinary shares and 1,000,000 pre-delivery shares to Streeterville Capital. This is a structured equity line (pre-paid advance #2) at 8% interest, with shares issuable at 85% of a discounted VWAP formula. The filing also covers resale by the investor. No board recommendation, no premium, no change of control. This is a routine at-the-market / PIPE-like takedown under an existing SPA, not a special situation. Watch for dilution mechanics and cash-flow triggers.
